messages.author: 35a15536b9cb2cf9
messages.subject: saving normalized gene expression values.
parts:
Hello Mark and Henrik,

Thanks for the replies. I got the CDF file that I needed. I appreciate
your help.

I've been reading http://groups.google.com/group/aroma-affymetrix/web/
and I have not found how to save normalized gene expression values. In
Affy, we can do

R> write.exprs(eset, file="mydata.txt")

and the values will be the text file.

Could anyone give some suggestions?

Thank you very much.

Hailong

messages.author: 1ff63ac4948de366
messages.subject: Re: [aroma.affymetrix] saving normalized gene expression values.
parts:
Hi Hailong.

You might first just grab the intensities into a data frame, like:

....
cesTr <- getChipEffectSet(plmTr)
trFit <- extractDataFrame(cesTr, units=1:3, addNames=TRUE)
....

(See full description at:
http://groups.google.com/group/aroma-affymetrix/web/human-exon-array-analysis)

and just use 'write.table' on trFit ... also keep in mind you may want
to take logs of the expression values in that data frame.

Cheers,
Mark
